description: Installation of an Air Source Heat Pump in the side area at the rear of the property, rebuilding the rear outrigger walls due to defective structure, changing the approved Crittall style double glazed windows and doors to the conservatory and rear bay to timber framed double glazed windows and doors in hardwood to match the style of the existing fenestration and building external pipes.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Location Plan, A691-PL21, A691-PL25-B, A691-PM07, A691-PM08, A691-PM09-A, A691/F01-C and Heritage, Design and Access Statement. Received: 21/11/2023
Photograph Sheets. Received: 11/12/2023
A691/P33, Plant Noise Assessment 1967-AF-00001-03. Received: 10/4/2024
A691-PL07-C, A691-PL08-D and A691-PL09-E. Received: 26/4/2024

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The enclosure of the heat pump shown on the approved drawings shall be installed within a month of this decision, and retained thereafter in accordance with the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) to which this permission refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the plant operate.
